body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> SanDisk presented its 64GB ultra backup USB flash drive at 2009 CES.
It comes with patent-pending backup technology with capacities up to 64GB, large enough to back up most average consumer requirements in addition to critical small business files and documents.
< AVING Special Report Team for 'CES 2009' : Idea Kim, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Paul Shin, Miso Kim, Esther Yoon, Abraham Shim, Grace Won, Risa Koo, JB Shim, Jini Shim >
